mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_browsing_history (user_id, target_type, target_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, target_type AS targetType, target_id AS targetId, view_time AS viewTime FROM user_browsing_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY view_time DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
